title: ConsentWithdrawn payload
description: A party withdrew a consent grant (CONSENT-003). Every consumer that processes data under the withdrawn uses must stop from withdrawnAt onwards. Carried inside the canonical envelope.

withdrawnUses.description: The uses that are no longer permitted. Stated explicitly so a consumer does not have to re-read the grant to know what to stop doing.

_note: Deliberately carries no withdrawalReason. A reason is optional for the party precisely so that withdrawing is never obstructed, and broadcasting one invites consumers to second-guess a decision that is not theirs to weigh.
